description: J.A. Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 25 May 1987 and began commercial production in April 1992 at its mill in Tehsil Jaranwala, District Faisalabad. It runs a spinning plant producing 100% cotton yarn and polyester/cotton yarn, and also offers knitted fabrics. The company's registered office is at JK House in Madina Town, Faisalabad, and its shares are listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: J.K House, 32-W Main Boulevard, Madina Town, Faisalabad, Pakistan

products.name: 100% cotton ring-spun and combed yarn
products.summary: Ring-spun and combed cotton yarn in counts from Ne 10/1 to Ne 40/1, sold under the company's JAT brand for weaving and knitting.

products.name: Polyester/cotton (PC) yarn
products.summary: PC yarn in counts from Ne 20/1 to Ne 52/1, for knitting or weaving.

products.name: Knitted fabrics
products.summary: Basic knitted fabrics in 20, 24 and 28 gauge and 26" or 30" diameter, including single jersey, pique, interlock, rib structures, fleece, single jersey jacquards and feeder stripes.
